verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an Uptime REST API with bearer-token auth, but the only endpoints shown are monitor CRUD. The MCP server is described only for telemetry: logs, metrics, traces and charts. Acknowledging and resolving incidents is documented only through phone keypress, mobile tap and Slack, which are chat or human channels rather than a programmatic API or MCP path, and escalation is policy-driven with no agent-callable endpoint shown.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can acknowledge, escalate, and resolve incidents end to end through a documented API or MCP connection — no dashboard in the loop
